About Halcyon Analytics
Halcyon Analytics helps hospitals forecast staffing needs with machine learning.

Data Science Intern, Summer 2027
Boston, MA (on-site)

What you'll do
- Build forecasting models in Python
- Present results to clinical operations leaders

Qualifications
- Undergraduate student pursuing a bachelor's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field.
- Working knowledge of Python and SQL.
- Experience with time-series forecasting is a plus.

This internship is open to rising seniors graduating in Spring 2028.
Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States; we do not offer visa sponsorship.
